holdmotor_baseline.note: torso target=0 the whole episode (arm_only baseline); this is the actuator work spent RESISTING reaction forces while nominally 'not moving', not zero as a naive reading of 'held' would suggest.

epistemic_caveat: contrib_torso_x/contrib_swing_x is an INSTANTANEOUS velocity-Jacobian decomposition (v_point = sum_i jacp[:,i]*qvel[i]) at each control step -- it shows which joint's angular velocity is contributing how much to the bat point's CURRENT velocity at that instant. It is NOT a measurement of energy or momentum transferred FROM one axis TO the other over time; no such flow analysis was performed, and this ratio should not be read as one.
